capabilities.description: What the Dot and panel UI may call: event listening, Dot dragging, opening web pages (sign-in), the shell commands (hiding the rose and the full-screen panel included), and the computer-control commands (yolo mode included: its native confirmation decides).
Only the panel may read its own visibility to start its assistant on first use.
Voice input (S30.1, S30.5): the panel's mic button records and transcribes natively, and the panel downloads, cancels, and removes the optional local voice model; the Dot never records.
The panel's Settings screen (S33): read and change the shortcut that opens the panel; the Dot never changes it.
Connector changes from the panel (S25.2): sent to the daemon over the app's private channel on behalf of the panel's window; the Dot and the web page cannot make them.
What the computer-control glow overlay (S28) may call: listening to the glow, working, and session events, and acknowledging that the working rings are on screen; nothing else.
Local desktop companion state independent of shared assistant persona.
Only settings can enable, disable or recall the desktop companion.
Only the traveler can pause its own motion and request bounded movement.
The transparent intro can read only allowlisted personal 2D artwork.
Access to chat and the native companion menu only. No daemon connection, files, voice or computer control.
Local transient context only. No daemon connection, files, voice, computer control or arbitrary window operations.
